acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: the treatment plant retains its municipal process silhouette while yellow isolation and red failed-process markings spread across pump and filtration zones
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: intake, clarification, filtration, disinfection, pump-out, maintenance and rejected-process routes remain physically understandable
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: tanks, pumps, fluid lines, chemical stores and isolated service stock make water continuity dependent on the same failing materials seen elsewhere
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: municipal utility markings remain utilitarian and unbranded, connecting the crisis directly to ordinary public-service infrastructure
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: some process trains remain active beside red-isolated lines and staged replacement parts, showing a plant losing redundancy one subsystem at a time
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed municipal water integrity log records repeated seal, pump and contamination problems threatening both potable water and waste handling
